Adyen is hiring a Junior Full-Stack Developer for its Documentation team. The role focuses on improving the developer experience through documentation-site UI updates, docs-as-code workflows, CMS integrations, and experimentation with data and AI.
Finance

Responsibilities
Enhance the Developer Experience: Give the Adyen Docs site a fresh coat of paint, align it with corporate branding, and build interactive, developer-focused elements
Tackle Technical Debt: Streamline our docs-as-code workflows and assist with Grav CMS integrations, clearing overhead so the wider team can move faster
Experiment with Data & AI: You will find new, interesting ways to proactively enhance the user and agent experience. You will also experiment with AI workflows to improve documentation speed
Formula Fit Execution: Champion the Adyen Formula by launching fast and iterating based on real-world feedback
Qualification
Full-Stack Web Development
JavaScript
HTML/CSS
Required
You have a 4-year Computer Science degree
a solid foundational understanding of full-stack web development, including modern JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and server-side/web technologies
You know how to accelerate your work with AI tools, but you possess the engineering rigor to validate AI outputs, catch algorithmic mistakes, and maintain clean code
You must be work authorized in the United States without the need for new visa sponsorship. The company can support visa transfers but will not sponsor individuals for H-1B CAP applications
Benefits
Equity (RSUs)
401(k)
Health, dental, and vision benefits
Based in the Chicago office; employees are expected to work in-office at least 3 days a week on average, while also supporting flexibility.
